thesis: NO TRADE. THE 22:00 NOTE'S HEADLINE WARNING CAME TRUE AND THE OPPOSITE ONE DID NOT. Its item (10) recorded, against interest, that the market broke down four minutes after the 22:00 decision; its next-task item (1) told this check to re-read everything from the 14:10Z bar forward. That is what happened: the 14:10Z five-minute bar is a market-wide flush - BNB O779.41/H780.90/L766.51 (range 1.877%, volume 1724.1M, the largest 5m bar of the day), ETH O2707.97/L2667.17 (1.634%), XRP O1.5754/L1.5268 (3.14%) - and BTC fell with them, so the move is REAL AND CROSS-CONFIRMED, not an artifact. BNB then made 761.25 (new 24h low) and ETH 2648.49. THE EVIDENCE GATE IS NOT WHAT REFUSED THIS CHECK. A BNB or ETH short has three arguable categories here - trend (BNB 1h unbroken lower highs 798.30 -> 797.68 -> 792.89 -> 792.35 -> 791.04 -> 788.63 -> 785.72 -> 786.19 -> 783.46 -> 783.05 -> 782.55, daily closes 799.71 -> 788.70 -> 766.74 all descending; ETH 1h lower highs 2786.81 -> 2779.32 -> 2760.32 -> 2753.89 -> 2748.23 -> 2740.37 -> 2736.85 -> 2727.77 -> 2722.14), volume (BNB 14:00Z 1h bar 7150.2M and ETH 7633.6M, the largest hourly prints of their respective 30-bar and 12-bar windows, i.e. genuine expansion ON the breakdown) and market_context (all five contracts fell together inside the same 5m bar). THE TRADE FAILS ON GEOMETRY AND ON EXECUTION, WHICH IS THE HONEST STATEMENT OF WHY, AND IT FAILS BECAUSE THE CHECK ARRIVED 55 MINUTES AFTER THE MOVE WITH PRICE 0.86% OFF THE LOW. (1) L-004 SPAN SCREEN, THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. BNB N (largest 5m range of the FULL preceding hour, 14:05Z-15:00Z) = 1.877% including the setup-defining 14:10Z bar, 1.083% excluding it - STATED BOTH WAYS AS THE 22:00 NOTE'S ITEM (3) REQUIRED, and note this is L-002's measurement problem running in the OPPOSITE direction from 22:00: N jumped from 0.224% to 1.877% because the flush bar ENTERED the window, so stops now look mechanically WORSE. That is not allowed to refuse a setup any more than the reverse was allowed to manufacture one - so the refusal below is priced against the SMALLER, honest-to-the-setup-bar N of 1.083%, and it still fails. A valid entry needs a span of at least 2.5N + ~0.14% drag = 2.85%. BNB short from bid 766.74 with the only noise-safe structural stop (780.90, the 14:10Z bar high, risk 1.846% = 1.70x N_excl) to the NEAREST structural target (757.90, the 09-19 daily low, reward 1.153%) pays NET 0.565 - barely a third of the floor. Reaching 1.5 net needs 744.17, BELOW the 09-20 daily low 747.64, 3.0% away THROUGH TWO UNTESTED SUPPORTS: not a target. (2) L-002 KILLS THE ONLY TIGHT STOP TWICE OVER. The alternative BNB short stop 769.49 is 0.359% away = 0.33x N_excl, sub-noise; AND 769.49 IS THE EXACT HIGH OF FOUR CONSECUTIVE 5m BARS (14:20Z, 14:25Z, 14:30Z, 14:35Z), a magnet level in the original formulation of the lesson - identical to the ETH 2722.14 construction refused at 22:00. (3) THE LONG SIDE WAS PRICED TOO AND REFUSED, WHICH MATTERS BECAUSE PRICE IS SITTING ON A REAL LEVEL. BNB 766.74-766.85 is the 09-21 daily low 766.72 to within two ticks - the very level every check since 20:00 used as its short TARGET. A long from ask 766.85, stop 758.55 (risk 1.083%, exactly N_excl, above the 09-19 low 757.90), target 780.90, pays NET 1.529 and is the only construction at this check that clears the floor. IT IS REFUSED ON L-004: the path to 780.90 jumps 769.49, a level that REJECTED FOUR CONSECUTIVE TIMES IN TWENTY MINUTES, with nothing structural in between because the 14:10Z bar fell straight through that whole range. A target reached only by jumping intervening rejected structure is not a target. It is also counter to every higher-timeframe read above, and the 09-21 daily low has been touched for MINUTES, not held into a shelf. (4) L-005 REFUSES ALL FIVE INDEPENDENTLY, AND THIS IS THE SEVENTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK. Four samples in 187 seconds (three sweeps plus a fourth, per the 22:00 note's item 7): NOT ONE CONTRACT HELD BOTH SIDES QUOTED ACROSS ALL FOUR. ETH bid 909,278 -> 48.2 -> 10.7 -> 910,586 USDT, unquoted on TWO CONSECUTIVE SAMPLES, an ~85,000x collapse and full recovery - the side a short must cross and a long must exit. BNB held the best bid of the five on all four samples (5,105,365 / 3,895,862 / 4,806,570 / 4,800,866) but its ASK collapsed to 99.8 USDT on sample 2 - so a long cannot enter and a short cannot exit. BTC ask 41,547 -> 1,520 -> 540 -> 58,507,791. XRP bid 3.8 -> 6,789,360 -> 31.7 -> 141.0, FOURTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK WITH AN XRP BID COLLAPSE. SOL bid 531.8 / ask 221.0 on sample 1. (5) L-003 REQUOTE, LEGITIMATE DIRECTION. BNB bid drifted 767.85 -> 766.97 -> 766.74 -> 766.74 across the samples, i.e. AWAY from any stop above: for the short the risk GREW and the ratio WORSENED, and chasing it means widening risk to keep the same target, which is equally a refusal. (6) L-001 APPLIED, AND THE 22:00 RE-TEST PROGRESS IS REVERSED WITHIN ONE HOUR - RECORDED, NOT ACTED ON. BTCUSDT printed THREE FRESH ARTIFACTS TODAY: 14:35Z 5m O84393.1/H85040.0/C84316.3, upper wick 0.767% on a 0.091% body = 8.4x; 14:40Z H84988.0 on a 0.044% body = 18.1x; 14:45Z H84766.9 on a 0.028% body = 20.8x. No other contract shows comparable upper wicks at those timestamps. The 22:00 check recorded 'the cleanest BTC scan of the experiment' and left the re-test clock to the review; ONE HOUR LATER THE SAME SCAN IS DIRTY. This is L-006 exactly: a rolling window walking over a quiet stretch was never evidence that a contract became readable. BTCUSDT is excluded a SIXTEENTH consecutive check. SOLUSDT excluded a SIXTH on the persisting 106.67 print, which still contaminates the live 24h low field (low24h 106.67 against a last of 115.10), and it also breached the 25 bps cap at 26.911 bps on sample 2. XRPUSDT excluded on the 1.6855 print, which STILL contaminates the live 24h high field (high24h 1.6855 against a last of 1.5293). (7) AGAINST INTEREST AND STATED PLAINLY: THE 22:00 DECLINED BNB SHORT WOULD HAVE PAID IN FULL. Entry 780.39, stop 783.46, target 766.72. Maximum print since the decision: 780.90 - THE STOP WAS NEVER TOUCHED. Low since: 761.25 - THE TARGET WAS REACHED AND EXCEEDED BY 0.71%. That is ONE completed instance of L-002's re-test condition (a setup declined under the rule reaching target without touching the noise-width stop); the condition requires THREE. The structural-stop variant (786.19) likewise never came close. ETH's declined short reached 2648.49, through 2687.56 but NOT through the 2641.70 that its passing construction required. PER THE STANDING RULE, THIS CHECK RECORDS THE INSTANCE AND APPLIES EVERY LESSON IN FULL; RETIRING OR LOOSENING ONE IS THE REVIEW'S CALL, NOT THIS CHECK'S. (8) NEWS AND EVENT RISK, RECORDED NOT CLAIMED. No verifiable scheduled release is tied to the 14:10Z flush; general coverage describes a broad pullback after BTC and ETH ran 14-15% into eight-month highs last week, so today's decline remains counter-trend on the weekly frame. The Trump-Xi summit and state dinner are TOMORROW, 09-24: anything opened now is held through the event, which is a further reason not to chase a 55-minute-old impulse at 0.86% off its low. (9) FUNDING UNREADABLE A FOURTH TIME.
